answer:

question: Which affidavits are required for the Dell laptop bid?
answer:
The PORFP requires a Mercury Affidavit. [Bid2: PORFP_-_Dell_Laptop_Final.pdf, p. 2]
For the manufacturer’s extended warranty, the documents say a warranty certificate or affidavit is to be presented upon award. [Bid2: PORFP_-_Dell_Laptop_Final.pdf, p. 3]
A Contract Affidavit form appears in the bid documents, but the documents shown do not state that it is required for submission of this bid. [Bid2: Contract_Affidavit.pdf, p. 1]

question: Compare the warranty requirements of Bid1 and Bid2.
answer:
Bid1 requires a 3-year minimum warranty for student and staff Windows laptops, and a 1-year minimum warranty for student Chromebooks. [Bid1: Addendum 1 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf, p. 3] [Bid1: Addendum 1 RFP JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices.pdf, p. 1]
Bid1’s device specifications also state 3-year minimum warranties for Tier 1 Staff Basic Laptop, Tier 2 Staff Laptop, and both Display Monitor types. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 6]
Bid1’s student tablet minimum requirements specify a 1-year minimum warranty. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 5]
Bid2 requires Dell’s limited hardware warranty extended for all machines purchased for 3 years. [Bid2: PORFP_-_Dell_Laptop_Final.pdf, p. 3]

question: What is the contract term and what renewal options are available?
answer:
The contract term is an initial 3-year term, with two successive 1-year renewals/extensions, for a maximum of 5 years total. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 2]
The RFP also states: Initial Term 3, Renewal 1 1, and Renewal 2 1. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 2]
Renewal depends on mutual agreement of the awarded vendor and the District. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 2]
If either party intends not to renew, that party must give written notice at least 90 days before expiration of the then-current term. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 2]

question: How may the proposal be submitted?
answer:
The proposal may be submitted online via the District’s electronic system. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 9]
Manual submissions may be delivered to the Procurement Services Department in a sealed envelope by the date and time stated. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 9]
A manual response may also be submitted by paper via mail/FedEx/UPS before the cutoff date and time. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 9]
No fax or email submissions will be accepted. [Bid1: JA-207652 Student and Staff Computing Devices FINAL.pdf, p. 9]
